title: Molecular Causes for BUBR1 Dysfunction in the Human Cancer Predisposition Syndrome Mosaic Variegated Aneuploidy
model: Published human MVA-derived cell lines and protein-replacement cell models; no supplied case analyzed
intervention: BUBR1 re-expression; protein turnover and HSP90/proteasome perturbations
observation: Re-expression restored checkpoint activity; defects included reduced protein abundance and intrinsic dysfunction. HSP90 inhibition depleted unstable proteins; MG132 prevented degradation experimentally.
contrary_or_limit: Protein stabilization alone does not establish restored attachment/checkpoint function. Immortalized and engineered cells do not establish clinical benefit.
evidence_access: Substantial primary-article text returned by web search index, including results; direct PMC open returned anti-bot page. Bibliographic metadata cross-checked through PubMed search.

title: Clearance of p16Ink4a-positive senescent cells delays ageing-associated disorders
intervention: AP20187-induced removal of p16-positive cells through engineered suicide construct
observation: Delayed selected tissue aging abnormalities; later treatment attenuated progression.
contrary_or_limit: Engineered clearance is not a transferable pharmacologic target in unmodified humans; no demonstration of corrected chromosome segregation; overall survival not substantially extended.
evidence_access: Primary PMC indexed excerpts and PubMed bibliographic record; direct PMC full-page open blocked. Survival limitation also visible in indexed reproduction of article text.

title: p21 Both Attenuates and Drives Senescence and Aging in BubR1 Progeroid Mice
model: BubR1 hypomorphic mice crossed with p53- or p21-null mice
intervention: Genetic deletion of p53 or p21
observation: Median survival shortened about 35%; p21 protected muscle/fat but promoted lens pathology.
contrary_or_limit: Tissue-specific opposing effects disfavor indiscriminate senescence suppression. Genetic lifelong loss is not equivalent to transient drug inhibition.
evidence_access: PMC full text accessed; results and survival figure legends examined.

title: SIRT2 induces the checkpoint kinase BubR1 to increase lifespan
model: Cell models; hypomorphic BubR1 mice with SIRT2 transgene; separate NMN mouse experiments
observation: SIRT2 transgenic expression increased hypomorphic-mouse lifespan. NMN increased BUBR1 abundance in vivo; indexed methods report 500 mg/kg/day intraperitoneally for seven days.
contrary_or_limit: NMN abundance experiment is not the transgenic lifespan experiment. No human developmental rescue, approved-drug substitute, or relevant human free exposure established.
evidence_access: Primary PMC indexed abstract/method excerpts and PubMed bibliographic record; direct PMC open blocked.

title: The Achilles' heel of senescent cells: from transcriptome to senolytic drugs
model: Senescent and proliferating human preadipocytes/endothelial cells; mouse studies
intervention: Dasatinib and quercetin, alone and together
observation: Cell-type-dependent selective killing. Example endothelial combination: 100 nM dasatinib plus 10 micromolar quercetin, three days, roughly half the senescent-cell viability remaining.
contrary_or_limit: Selective elimination is not repair; continuous culture exposure is not a human free-exposure profile. Not a human constitutional BUB1B rescue study.
evidence_access: PubMed/PMC indexed abstract and primary PDF indexed results excerpt (PMC4531078 PDF); direct full-page opens blocked. No large download performed.

title: MTOR regulates the pro-tumorigenic senescence-associated secretory phenotype by promoting IL1A translation
model: Human cell senescence and tumor-microenvironment experiments, not constitutional BUB1B deficiency
observation: Suppressed IL1A translation and downstream inflammatory secretion; indexed results describe maximal IL6 suppression below 10 nM.
contrary_or_limit: Supports a downstream secretion comparator, not chromosome correction; relevant tissue exposure and developmental benefit unestablished.
evidence_access: Primary PMC indexed abstract/results excerpts and PubMed metadata; direct PMC page/PDF-param opens blocked or errored.

title: SIROLIMUS tablet — U.S. prescribing information, Dr. Reddy's Laboratories
model: Official U.S. prescription label; revision September 2023
observation: Renal-transplant and lymphangioleiomyomatosis indications. Label warns of infection/malignancy under immunosuppression and impaired healing. About 92% plasma binding; strong blood-cell partitioning; CYP3A/P-gp interactions.
contrary_or_limit: Label does not establish BUB1B efficacy or safe developmental use. Blood, plasma and free concentrations cannot be equated.
evidence_access: DailyMed full label accessed; indications, warnings, distribution, interactions and revision date checked. This is the retrieved label revision, not a claim to have compared all marketed formulations.

title: SPRYCEL (dasatinib) — U.S. prescribing information
model: Official U.S. prescription label; prescribing-information revision September 2026
observation: Leukemia indications; myelosuppression, bleeding, fluid retention, cardiovascular/pulmonary and pediatric bone-growth warnings. Approximately 96% plasma binding and 3–5-hour terminal half-life; CYP3A interactions.
contrary_or_limit: Oncology approval does not establish a safe senolytic indication, combination approval or constitutional BUB1B benefit. Sustained culture exposure is not clinical exposure.
evidence_access: DailyMed full prescribing information accessed. Main prescribing-information revision is September 2026; embedded patient information separately states February 2023.

title: Elevating the frequency of chromosome mis-segregation as a strategy to kill tumor cells
model: Human tumor cell lines with inducible Mps1 or BubR1 depletion
intervention: Checkpoint protein depletion combined with low taxol
observation: Increased severe chromosome errors and reduced long-term viability; early survival can miss later death after divisions.
contrary_or_limit: Cancer-cell killing has opposite intent from preserving constitutionally deficient normal tissue; no correction or treatment-safety inference.
evidence_access: Extensive primary PMC indexed results text and PNAS/PubMed bibliographic metadata; direct PMC open blocked.

title: P53 independent pathogenic mechanisms contribute to BubR1 microcephaly
model: Mouse cortical BubR1 conditional knockout, with and without Trp53 co-deletion
observation: Persistent DNA damage and P53-independent death; minimal improvement in cortical size/neuron numbers.
contrary_or_limit: Near-complete developmental loss differs from hypomorphism and human allele combinations; directly challenges an apoptosis-suppression shortcut, without establishing all drug effects.
evidence_access: Publisher full text accessed, including abstract, model distinctions and results summary. PMID not independently verified and intentionally left null.
